note: WarehouseExportBuffer / build_jsonl golden bytes: manifest line {'_manifest': {...}} (sort_keys, compact) then one line per row {'_opengtm_lead_id': id, **payload} (sort_keys, compact, ensure_ascii=True; a payload '_opengtm_lead_id' overrides the id), each newline terminated; records_sha256 = sha256 over the record lines only. Golden files live under testdata/warehouse/ and are compared byte for byte. `spill` was built with max_memory_bytes=4096 (rolled to disk); output is identical to the in-memory path.
